subject: Moscone Summit 2026: island footprint, branded kiosks, and last-mile collateral
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Julia Rios <julia@alliedexhibits.com>, Mike Hsu <mike@pixelprints.com>, Sarah Lopez <sarah@acmemktg.com>
Cc: Convention Center Ops <ops@mc_convention.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Moscone Summit 2026: island footprint, branded kiosks, and last-mile collateral

Team & partners — attaching the latest 10x20 island footprint (D3) and the signage kits quote from PixelPrints. Key asks and deadlines below: 

Attachments: booth_floor_D3_10x20_v5.pdf; signage_kits_quote_20261112.pdf

Summary and asks:
- Floorplan: we’ve landed on an island (10x20) with two branded kiosks (front left + back-right) and an open demo area. Please review the footprint and confirm any show-floor egress or power concerns by EOD 11/18 (venue needs final layout).
- Signage: PixelPrints provided a base kit (backwall, two pull-ups, 6 directional placards). Need approval or edits by 11/20 to hit print deadlines.
- Collateral: Marissa — can you confirm final counts for one-pagers, stickers, and swag crates? We’ll need exact crate counts for Allied’s freight estimate.
- Power / electrical: Allied — confirm drop location and 20A availability for the two kiosks. If we need a distro, flag asap.

Important notes: the venue wants a signed floorplan and exhibitor services order before 11/19 to avoid a surcharge. I’d like to avoid rush fees.

Next steps: Please reply in-thread with approvals or changes. If you’re approving, include any PO/DocuSign reference so procurement can proceed.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior BD Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

From: Julia Rios <julia@alliedexhibits.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>; Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>; Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Hsu <mike@pixelprints.com>, Convention Center Ops <ops@mc_convention.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Moscone Summit 2026: island footprint, branded kiosks, and last-mile collateral

Ben — thanks for the plan. Quick notes from Allied Exhibits after a site-scan and preliminary estimate attached.

Attachments: exhibitor_services_estimate.pdf

- Power: We see existing floor drops in the north aisle close to the proposed kiosks, but they are 15A by default. Kiosks with monitors + tablets will likely require a 20A drop or a small distro. If you can confirm max load per kiosk (Diego), we’ll size correctly.
- Aisle flow: the planned front-left kiosk partially blocks the immediate entrance sightline; recommend rotating that kiosk 90° and shifting the demo table 24" toward the center to improve circulation. This keeps the same footprint but improves traffic.
- Freight: Allied recommends 3 crates (one large crate for booth shell, two crates for collateral + hardware) to stay within move-in window pricing. Additional crates add $320/crate.

If you’d like, we can produce a revised CAD with the rotated kiosk and updated quote by EOD 11/16.

—Julia
Julia Rios
Project Manager, Allied Exhibits
julia@alliedexhibits.com | +1 628-555-0144

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Julia Rios <julia@alliedexhibits.com>, Mike Hsu <mike@pixelprints.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Moscone Summit 2026: island footprint, branded kiosks, and last-mile collateral

Ben / all — quick internal check from events ops: I support Allied’s rotation suggestion to keep sightlines clear. Marissa, please confirm quantities below so we can finalize crate counts: 
- One-pagers (product one-sheet): 500 initial + 150 reserve?
- Stickers (small logo): 800
- Swag (lanyards): 250

Budget: if we add 150 extra one-pagers that’s ~ $140 for printing + $45 additional crate fee — still within the event budget but need Marissa’s OK.

Also, PixelPrints: can you confirm the backwall finish option A (matte) vs B (satin) and lead time if we add custom die-cut directional placards?

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Field Marketing Lead, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-16T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Moscone Summit 2026: island footprint, branded kiosks, and last-mile collateral

Ben / team — confirmed counts and vendor notes: 
Attachments: collateral_count_sheet.xlsx; signage_kits_quote_20261112.pdf

- One-pagers: ordering 650 total (500 deploy + 150 reserve). Acme Marketing (Sarah) will print and deliver to Allied’s warehouse on 11/30 for move-in.
- Stickers: 800 (vendor already on it).
- Lanyards: moving to 300 to match expected attendee traffic.
- Kiosk tablets: 2 tablets, we need tablet mounts — will order mounts via Diego.

Budget: incremental prints + crate fee = $185. Approving within events budget. Please sign PO so we can finalize.

Sarah (Acme) — please confirm ETA for the printed one-pagers and whether rush charges apply if artwork updates after 11/18.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Events Program Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0112

Thanks everyone — approving the rotated kiosk layout and Marissa’s counts. A couple small additions before we finalize: 

- Please add two tablet wall mounts (kiosk_specs.xlsx) and one surge-protected power strip per kiosk. Diego, can you place the mount/power orders today?
- Allied — proceed with 3 crates as recommended. Please update the exhibitor services estimate and send the final CAD with the rotated kiosk.
- PixelPrints/Sarah — please confirm backwall finish = Matte (option A) and confirm whether die-cut directional placards add >48 hours to print lead time.

I’ve attached a draft PO for procurement. Once Diego confirms mounts/power, I’ll sign and push to DocuSign.

Attachments: PO_#7823_draft.pdf; kiosk_specs.xlsx

Ben Carter
